output.summary: The diff replaces Array.prototype.includes with a Set-based membership check in hasRequiredRoles. This is behavior-preserving for the documented contract: requiredRoles.every still requires every role; empty requiredRoles still yields true (empty access permitted); and both includes and Set.has use SameValueZero comparison, which for string roles is case-sensitive exact equality. No correctness, security, concurrency, reliability, or regression issues were identified. The change is a safe performance optimization (O(n*m) to O(n+m) expected lookup).
